$comment: Machine-readable freshness registry — the single source of truth for WHEN every data class is meant to refresh and how stale it is allowed to get. Consumed by scripts/check_freshness.mjs (CI/owner check), lib/freshness.ts (the /api/freshness route), and validate-data (WARN wiring). See docs/WAYFINDER_LIVE_DATA.md for the cadence table and activation matrix. Keep entries in lockstep with the workflows in .github/workflows and the refresh scripts in scripts/.

datasets.label: London pint-price dataset

stamp.consumedBy: lib/dataFreshness.ts PINT_DATASET_OBSERVED_AT (build-time import; this stamp is the single source of truth for the pint dataset's collection date — the TS constant is derived from it, never hand-authored)

datasets.cadence: episodic — re-collected by hand, then re-exported

datasets.label: Cheapest-pint baseline price updates
datasets.gate: none to run; first-party parsers are STUBBED (fetchFromSource returns []), so a run is a safe no-op until a per-source parser lands

datasets.label: Per-drink price updates
datasets.gate: none to run; only allowlisted first-party source (Wetherspoons) has no per-drink web prices, so the pipeline is real but emits zero rows

datasets.label: Night signals (offline-reviewed claims)
datasets.gate: EXA_API_KEY arms candidate ingestion; without it the reviewed snapshot publishes empty (staged candidates only). Every claim still passes human review before it ships.

datasets.label: What's-On (sport / quiz / deals / music / events)
datasets.cadence: target daily 15:45 UTC (events vertical); baseline verticals episodic
datasets.refreshWorkflow: What's-On events refresh (feat/event-sources — cron commented out until keys)
datasets.gate: TICKETMASTER_API_KEY and/or SKIDDLE_API_KEY (Skiddle needs written commercial approval). Baseline rows are hand-verified transforms; live layer also blends CityMCP at request time.

datasets.label: London Pint Index (borough medians)
datasets.cadence: event-sourced — grows as confirmed Pint Drops / official-publisher observations arrive
datasets.refreshWorkflow: user-cadence (the growth loop IS the refresh mechanism)
datasets.gate: none; only confirmed Pint Drops + official-publisher / open-data sources are eligible

datasets.label: Late-food evidence
datasets.cadence: episodic — evidenced by hand per Night Area

datasets.label: PUBMAXXING all-drinks / history seed import
datasets.cadence: episodic — imported from the sibling pubmaxxing repo

datasets.label: Wetherspoons venue-presence directory (OSM)
datasets.gate: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY for the directory refresh path; OSM Overpass is keyless

datasets.label: TfL last-train / last-drink (live)
datasets.cadence: live — fetched per request from api.tfl.gov.uk, never disk-cached
datasets.gate: none (keyless); TFL_APP_KEY only raises rate limits

datasets.label: CityMCP London (buzz / status / journey / places)
datasets.cadence: live — proxied per request with short in-process TTLs (3–10 min)
datasets.gate: none (keyless upstream); buzz digest quality depends on CityMCP's own EXA-backed enrichment
